positioning_check: Short interest 76.63M shares as of the 2026-10-15 settlement, 5.2 days to cover, against 321.34M shares outstanding (~23.8% of shares out), up from 65.99M / 5.8 days at 2026-09-30 (https://massive.com/quote/corz, fetched 2026-11-04; Sep 30 and Sep 15 figures per Curved Trading's FINRA table via search, https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/corz/short-interest/). Shorts were BUILDING into the print. Baseline: 25-delta skew +9.99 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.70, ATM IV 156%, spot $12.835 is 2.6% above the 52-week low, -14.4% over 5 sessions, -19.5% over 20, and -9.8% on 2026-11-04 itself. A crowded, building short at the low is a squeeze mechanism on any reassurance; the put skew says the options market pays for further downside.

findings.finding: Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa (elected 2026-11-03) campaigned on pausing NEW data-center permits until the legislature writes water/power rules and on repealing the 20-year hyperscale tax exemption; Core Scientific has 4 of its 11 facilities in Texas, including the greenfield Hunt County site (land + ~430 MW gross power bought May 2026 for ~$233M, ~110 MW leased to AMD) and Pecos (~185 MW leased to AMD), so ~295 of the ~377 MW direct AMD leases sit in Texas. CORZ fell 9.8% on 2026-11-04 ($14.24 to ~$12.84) with IREN -9%, CoreWeave -6/-8%. The 2026-11-05 08:30 ET call is the first time management can say whether those sites are already permitted/under construction (the proposals target new approvals, she takes office in January, and Republicans likely keep the Texas Senate).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned on a permitting shock. On sector-macro shocks the stock has moved with the group: -12%+ with miners/CoreWeave on the hot-CPI day in mid-October 2026 (https://finance.biggo.com/news/192e1de3-32ac-4676-841e-a0be41717081) and -5% on the 2026-09-15 yields selloff (https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/09/15/applied-digital-falls-4-and-turns-negative-for-the-year-as-the-ai-buildout-trade-bleeds-out-core-scientific-drops-5-cipher-mining-sinks-4/).
findings.why_not_priced: The threat itself is priced (that is today's -9.8%); what is not priced is management's answer on permit status, which no one has heard. If the market had already resolved it, the stock would not have fallen 3.5 points more than IREN-type peers' premarket moves suggested and the put skew would not be bid. Most of CORZ's Texas exposure (Denton, Pecos) is existing powered sites, and Hunt County power was contracted in May, which makes a reassuring answer more likely than not, but a 'not yet permitted' on Hunt County is the left tail.
findings.independence: Site facts from the company's Q2 10-Q (Hunt County, 4 of 11 Texas facilities): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001839341/000183934126000014/core-20260630.htm ; AMD site split (Pecos 185 MW, Hunt 110 MW) from https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/core-scientific-secures-amd-as-customer-at-five-sites/ ; the day's sector move from https://www.tikr.com/blog/iren-sinks-9-coreweave-down-6-as-democrats-win-congress-cramer-warns-be-careful and https://rallies.ai/news/ai-data-center-stocks-dip-renewables-surge-after-democrat-sweep-in-us-midterm-elections-a061c4d43cbee7e7 (federal-oversight angle merged in here, same day, same move).

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline: 5 of 7 prior prints up, median |move| 6.18%; the two that fell (-9.22% 2026-05-06, -7.22% 2026-03-02) were amc prints in a period of rising stock; the last print (2026-07-28, bmo) was +0.02% on a 13% revenue beat.

findings.finding: CoreWeave, which was ~77% of Core Scientific's H1 2026 revenue, traded as distressed credit in October 2026 (2031 bonds yielding above 16% on 2026-10-14/15, five-year CDS above 1,000-1,140bp on 2026-10-27/28, S&P B+, ~$50bn debt); CoreWeave reports 2026-11-10, after the window, so CORZ's call is the market's only read before then on whether CoreWeave payments, the remaining ~150 MW Dalton Phase II, or lease terms have changed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Customer-concentration news has moved CORZ before: the stock fell ~7% on the multi-billion CoreWeave deal announcement (https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/software/nasdaq-corz/core-scientific/news/why-core-scientific-corz-is-down-70-after-striking-multi-bil) and dropped with CoreWeave on the October credit days; no print has yet carried a tenant-credit disclosure.
findings.why_not_priced: The credit stress is public and mostly in the price (CORZ is -56% from its high); what is not priced is any CORZ-side disclosure: a receivable aging, a deferral request, a lease amendment or a change in the CoreWeave-funded build-out credits. Absent such a disclosure this finding is near zero; with one it is a large negative. Sized small and negative because a crowded short already holds much of this view.
findings.independence: Customer share 77%: https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/software/nasdaq-corz/core-scientific/news/what-does-core-scientific-corz-need-to-prove-as-customer-ris/amp ; CoreWeave earnings date 2026-11-10 via https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/x/CRWV ; AMD's ~1.9-2 GW reservation and ~530 MW contracts are the offset (net of the rest of the company: AMD + Neocloud ~530 MW of 1.1 GW leased capacity, but AMD revenue starts only in early 2027).

findings.finding: The company's own run-rate implies Q3 revenue near the middle of a disputed consensus: 437 MW billing by mid-July = ~$635M annualized colocation GAAP revenue (~$159M a quarter at a flat 437 MW, versus Q2 colocation $136.7M), plus self-mining and hosting that fell from $37.7M (Q1) to $27.5M (Q2) with ~30% fewer miners online, giving roughly $175-190M total against estimates of $169.7M-$198.4M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue $164.2M beat $144.8M consensus by 13% and the stock moved +0.02% (baseline, 2026-07-28 bmo; https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-28-core-scientific-inc-stock/). Revenue beats have not been bought.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: it lands inside what management told the market ('another meaningful step-up'), and the low estimates ($170-173M) look stale against a run-rate the company disclosed in July, which is the only reason it carries a positive sign. If the market expected a large beat, the last beat would not have been met with a flat tape.
findings.independence: Q2 call detail (437 MW mid-July, ahead of plan; mining wind-down) from the MarketBeat call summary https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-28-core-scientific-inc-stock/ ; same underlying company disclosure, so not independent.

findings.finding: AMD reported Q3 2026 on 2026-11-03 with Data Center revenue +97% y/y and a Q4 outlook of accelerating growth on data-center demand; AMD is Core Scientific's second anchor (15-year leases ~377 MW direct plus credit support for a ~152 MW Neocloud lease, ~$14bn base revenue, exclusive reservation of up to ~2 GW more, warrants vesting at 12,222 shares per MW leased), so the counterparty that must convert reservation into leases reported strong demand the day before CORZ's call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The AMD partnership announcement with the Q2 print lifted CORZ ~6% premarket (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/amd-stock-falls-4-despite-193833214.html), yet the day closed +0.02% per the baseline.
findings.why_not_priced: AMD's print is a counterparty datum that arrived after Core Scientific last spoke; it is a proxy (AMD did not name CORZ), so it is small. If the market had read through, CORZ would not have closed at a 52-week low the next day.
findings.independence: AMD deal terms: https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/core-scientific-secures-amd-as-customer-at-five-sites/ ; proxy only, no AMD statement on CORZ capacity found.

findings.finding: Q3 GAAP EPS will likely carry a large non-cash warrant gain: warrant liabilities were $1,975.3M at June 30, 2026 (96.4M Tranche 1 warrants at $6.81 strike expiring 2027-01-23, 6.6M Tranche 2 at $0.01), Level 1 fair value, and the stock fell from roughly the mid-$20s implied at June 30 to about $16 in September, implying a gain on the order of $0.9-1.0bn and a positive GAAP EPS against a -$0.03 consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 GAAP EPS -$3.32 against -$0.06 consensus, driven by a $1,045.5M warrant fair-value loss; stock moved +0.02% (baseline; https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-28-core-scientific-inc-stock/). The market looks through this line.
findings.why_not_priced: A mechanical headline 'EPS beat' that screens and algos may print at 07:00; it has no path to guidance or cash, which is why it is sized at a fraction. September price from https://www.digrin.com/stocks/detail/CORZ/price (monthly figure $15.98, basis unstated), so the gain estimate is approximate.
findings.independence: Q2 release shows the warrant line in the net loss: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001839341/000183934126000013/q22026corescientificinc-ea.htm ; same company documents.

findings.finding: The AMD build needs ~$6bn ($11-12M per MW on ~530 MW, 'financed mainly through project-level bonds') plus up to ~$1bn to advance ~500 MW ahead of contracts, against $1.82bn liquidity at June 30; no project financing for the AMD sites has been announced since (the last raise was the $3.3bn 7.75% secured notes, closed 2026-05-06), and on 2026-11-04 Applied Digital's CEO said 800 MW of its capacity still needs financing, putting funding at the centre of the sector tape.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The $3.3bn notes plan in April 2026 was met with a rise (https://rallies.ai/news/core-scientific-rises-as-33b-notes-plan-and-15gw-pecos-expansion-stay-in-focus).
findings.why_not_priced: Asked what the money buys: contracted 15-year AMD leases with AMD credit support, the same structure the May notes financed. So a financing announced with the print is a positive and a 'still working on it' is a modest negative in a market where CoreWeave bonds yield >15%; sign is left at zero because neither answer is evidenced.
findings.independence: $3.3bn notes terms: https://www.cahill.com/news/firm-news/2026-05-06-cahill-represents-initial-purchasers-in-core-scientific-33-billion-notes-offering ; Applied Digital financing comment via https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/26/11/62856685/crwv-apld-iren-stocks-slip-as-brad-gerstner-warns-democratic-midterm-gains-could-put-10-15-gw-of-ai-dat ; 2029 converts ($460M, $11.00 conversion, convertible in Q3) from the 10-Q are a dilution overhang near spot.

outside_window.finding: CoreWeave's own Q3 2026 report (expected 2026-11-10 amc) is the direct read on the tenant's liquidity and any landlord renegotiation.
IREN reports fiscal Q1 on Thursday 2026-11-05 (after the close per the TIKR piece's 'due Thursday'), and TeraWulf on 2026-11-06 before its 8:00 ET call; peer reads land after CORZ's window closes.
Hinojosa takes office in January 2027; any actual Texas permit pause or tax-exemption repeal needs executive action or the legislature.
